title: 第8章 一波小热度
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在接下来一周，贺舟才知道，原来是因为一个网站贴子带来的流量。

过来的都是来看热闹的画手同行。

里边还时不时会出现：

【田小西以前是不是请枪手了？她以前的画功在我们网站都能卷到前三吧。】

【那肯定的，不然她这种狗屎剧情怎么签约的，就是因为画功太强了。】

【就算是假装用线稿这种抽象的方式，其实专业的人的线条还是能看出来的，但是这个线条一看就没学过……】

专业的人线条里有一种独特的美感，哪怕在伪装新手，也很容易被人看出来。

原本已经凉了的热度，忽然又在漫画圈里热议了一下。

虽然贴吧已经没什么用了，但是漫画作家论坛还是很出名的，大部分刚入行的漫画作家很爱在里边发帖。

偶尔一些资深的漫画大佬也会进去回答一下大家的问题。

一个帖子有个几十个回答就算是热帖了。

“枪手？”

“我的绝世画功需要请枪手？”

“他们疯了吗？”

田小西冷笑，不屑地想

她的每一张画！每一根线条！都充斥着绝世……啊！等等！这是什么东西！！

出现在她眼前的，是一只线条凌乱！毫无美感！比房子还大的！比幼儿园小朋友还画得差的大胖鹰！

“……”

田小西倒吸一口凉气。

拿着手机的手都在颤抖！

她很想把那个该死的枪手揪出来，为什么就非得让这个NPC画这个该死的漫画！

她的一世英名啊！

生气的时候。

田小西一眼就看到该死的竟然漫画又更新了！

更让人惊奇的是…

那可怜兮兮D就在她眼皮子底下留言。

【哈哈！终于更新了！我太好奇了！有活！这本漫画太有活了！】

【你们别光顾着哈哈哈啊，贺舟终于更新第四话第五话了！我今天要爽看！】

“他们竟然连这个NPC的名字都

田小西往底下一看。

在看到更新两话的抽象程度时，差点气得撅过去。

剧情简单至极！

第四话就是黑猫警长调查公螳螂的死因，发现是母螳螂吃的。

而第五话则是一只肥硕的老鼠杀害了白猫，最后和黑猫警长一阵缠斗之后，成功地抓到了坏人。

简单到几乎弱智的剧情！

勉强可以划分为热血番。

结束的画面则是一只简笔画的猫用枪指着天，旁边有四个字：【请看下集】

“他为什么会觉得有人想看下集！”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the next week, He Zhou found out that it was because of the traffic brought by a website post.

Those who came here were all fellow painters who came to see the fun.

It also appears from time to time:

[Did Tian Xiaoxi hire a gunman before?Her previous painting skills were ranked among the top three on our website.】

[That’s for sure, otherwise how could she have signed a contract for a bullshit plot like this? It’s just because her drawing skills are too strong.】

[Even if you pretend to use an abstract method like line drawing, you can still see the lines of a professional, but I haven’t learned this line at a glance...]

There is a unique beauty in the lines of a professional person, and it is easy to be seen even if he is pretending to be a novice.

The heat that had already cooled down suddenly became hotly discussed in the comics circle again.

Although the post bar is no longer useful, the comic writer forum is still very famous, and most comic writers who are new to the industry love to post there.

Occasionally, some senior comics experts will come in to answer everyone's questions.

A post is considered a hot post if it has dozens of responses.

"Gunner?"

"Do I need to hire a gunman for my superb painting skills?"

"Are they crazy?"

Tian Xiaoxi sneered and thought disdainfully

Every one of her paintings!Every line!They are all filled with peerless...ah!etc!What is this!!

What appeared before her eyes was a bird with messy lines!No sense of beauty!Bigger than a house!A big fat eagle that is worse than a kindergarten kid!

"..."

Tian Xiaoxi took a breath of cold air.

The hand holding the phone is shaking!

She really wanted to find out that damn gunman, why did she have to let this NPC draw this damn comic!

Her lifelong fame!

When you are angry.

Tian Xiaoxi saw at a glance that the comic had been updated again!

What’s even more surprising is…

That pitiful D left a message right under her nose.

【Ha ha!Finally updated!I'm so curious!There is life!This comic is so lively!】

[Don’t just look around, hahaha, He Zhou has finally updated the fourth and fifth chapters!I want to have fun today!】

"They didn't even know the name of this NPC.

Tian Xiaoxi looked down.

When I saw the level of abstraction in the two updated chapters, I almost pouted in anger.

The plot is extremely simple!

In the fourth episode, Sheriff Black Cat investigates the cause of death of the male praying mantis and discovers that it was eaten by the female praying mantis.

In the fifth episode, a fat mouse killed the white cat. After a fight with the black cat sergeant, he successfully caught the bad guy.

The plot is so simple that it’s almost mentally retarded!

It can barely be classified as a hot-blooded series.

The ending scene is a simple cat pointing a gun at the sky, with four words next to it: [Please watch the next episode]

“Why would he think someone wants to watch the next episode!"
